nodes.problem: Hardcoded PROVEN_GATES set assigned PROVEN status from gate identity rather than fresh proof.
nodes.rootCause: Lack of dynamic PROOF_INDEX evaluation in artifact generator.
nodes.selectedSolution: Load PROOF_INDEX.json dynamically and evaluate gate verification based on fresh test artifacts and SHA.
If any internally solvable P0 is unresolved, mission_state = EXECUTING. TARGET_PROVEN is COMPUTED from evidence only when unresolved_p0 === 0.

nodes.problem: Stale competing acceptance authorities and legacy 27-gate registries.
nodes.selectedSolution: MASTER_ACCEPTANCE_REGISTRY.json is sole active authority with 267 registered gates.

nodes.problem: Requirement lifecycle and fresh evidence pointers missing.
nodes.selectedSolution: Create PROOF_INDEX.json with source_sha, command_probe, artifact, timestamp, and invalidation dependencies.

nodes.rootCause: All non-proven gates were lumped together.
nodes.selectedSolution: Classified into A (Missing/Wrong), B (Implemented not cut over), C (Insufficient proof), D (Superseded/External blocker).

nodes.problem: Worker persisted scan_runs.status = 'partial' violating scan_runs_status_check constraint.
nodes.rootCause: Conflation of execution lifecycle with result quality.

nodes.problem: Worker inferred failure class from missing or generic last_error string.
nodes.selectedSolution: Every window emits typed outcome (COMPLETE, VERIFIED_EMPTY, DEGRADED_FALLBACK, RATE_LIMITED, NETWORK_ERROR, PROVIDER_ERROR, PARSER_SCHEMA_DRIFT, UNSUPPORTED, UNKNOWN_ERROR).

nodes.problem: Edge function failed with HTTP 546 WORKER_RESOURCE_LIMIT due to 5,000 in-memory rows and hundreds of sequential deals upserts.
nodes.selectedSolution: Bounded 300 rows/invocation budget, bulk upsert of deals and snapshots in 2 bulk queries, keyset continuation.

nodes.problem: Analyzer orchestrator warned on batch limit and exited 0, pretending green completion on partial source data.
nodes.selectedSolution: Orchestrator loops with bounded 300-row batches up to source exhaustion. Fails with exit code 1 if budget reached with pending records.

nodes.rootCause: Failure A (constraint violation) and Failure B (worker resource limit).
nodes.selectedSolution: Deploy migrations and edge functions, then trigger and verify discovery pipeline in production.
